body:
Carry out D-265 points 1 and 2 for feature:21d501a74aec4f44. No review entries are written yet; a later task adds them.

- Every project's top folder gets one `SYSTEMREVIEWS.md`, created where `DECISIONS.md` is created (D-254 point 1): at setup, when a project is added, and by migration. A file that already exists is kept as it is.
- Agents can `read` it. `write`, `remove` and `move` refuse to change it, and the refusal says that only Solace writes this file.
- Solace gets one internal way to append an entry to it, for the review task to use later.

Done when: tests show the file is created in all three cases, an existing file is left alone, `read` works and `write`/`remove`/`move` are refused.
title: sysreview: SYSTEMREVIEWS.md log file
